steps.title: Sections
steps.answer:
(def verse
  (fm1 :len 8 c e g e c e g e)
  (fm2 :oct 2 :len 2 c g))
(def chorus
  (fm1 :len 8 f a > c < a g b > d < b)
  (fm2 :oct 2 :len 2 f g))
verse verse chorus
